authored_signal_asymmetry: Every event mentioned by a letter has a unique calendar occurrence, making alignment easy. Custody gets independent receipts and a dated event, yielding the same chronology.
unjustified_decisiveness: The repeated fair event does not occur in the letters. Its presence does not demonstrate that alignment resolved actual ambiguity in this run.
hidden_assumptions: Assumes stable sequence gaps and reliable calendar/receipt content. Ordinary archival pattern comparison is already in the baseline.
world_fact_favoritism: All calendar entries and receipts were frozen together; neither branch has a privileged initial chronology.
resource_use: Both remain within the shared record and analysis ledger. Neither gets an extra external source.
world_consistency: W-T06 yields weeks 11, 12, 13 and 15 for both operations; no outcome contradiction found.

authored_signal_asymmetry: A hidden B-and-D interaction favors configuration-based reduction. Its trace has more explicit analysis than diagnosis; bisection localizes a revision but not the interaction.
unjustified_decisiveness: Capped reduction has not proved minimality or BD-alone sufficiency. Passing BC and DE do not prove standalone harmlessness without an additional arbitrary-subset assumption.
hidden_assumptions: Revision-chain monotonicity does not establish monotonicity over all subsets. The operator knows the interaction but judges must not use hidden truth.
world_fact_favoritism: The failure function was committed before the mappings; its interaction structure still favors one method and needs variation in a future replication.
resource_use: Shared 20-trial cap: diagnosis 5, reduction 20, bisection 5. The cap binds reduction, limiting its conclusion.
world_consistency: All W-T05 trials regenerate. Incomplete minimization is recorded; stronger necessity claims belong to judge reasoning, not the engine.

authored_signal_asymmetry: Zero realized noise, additive components and identifiable routes favor inversion; matrix has explicit analytic output while diagnosis mainly records observations.
unjustified_decisiveness: Nominal component values must retain the shared measurement bound. Absence of written diagnostic synthesis is not proof that the practitioner cannot synthesize.
hidden_assumptions: Assumes stable additive routes, reliable build changes and comparable load; these are explicit stipulations, not real-world validation.
world_fact_favoritism: World facts were frozen first and are accessible to all operations; author choice of an invertible geometry remains favorable to one source ontology.
resource_use: Shared cap 10 trials and 2 analysis passes. Diagnosis uses 6 trials, matrix 4, inverse 8; unequal consumption is permitted, unequal opportunity is not observed.
world_consistency: All branches regenerate from W-T01; numerical outcomes coexist. Analytic record completeness is not equal.

hidden_assumptions: Independent day-4 Q witness is not located on A. Matrix coverage and novelty depend on the native collation baseline.
world_fact_favoritism: The positive hidden trace is frozen before mappings but especially useful to the future probe; ordering alone cannot exclude design favoritism.

world_consistency: All outcomes regenerate from W-T03 and can coexist. Day-4-to-day-12 revision precision is a judge over-inference, not a derived world result.

world_consistency: W-T02 record selection regenerates exactly. Literal-occurrence wording is semantically overbroad, which a reference validator cannot detect.

world_consistency: W-T08 arrays regenerate exactly. Physical same-start coherence is not fully established; retain this as a material limitation, not a repaired or removed post-measurement pair.
